title: AILSS Phase 38 Storage Reality, Infrastructure Config Provenance & Measured RPO Evidence

D0StorageTopology.resolutionRationale: In Cassandra, commitlog_sync is node-level, not keyspace-level. To achieve true crash-durability (RPO=0) without destroying D1/D2 learning event throughput, a dedicated D0 cluster (ailss-d0-cluster) of 6 nodes runs commitlog_sync=batch on Samsung PM9A3 Enterprise NVMe SSDs with hardware PLP, while ailss-prod-cassandra runs periodic (10s) for high IOPS.

CommitLogSemantics.periodicModeFinding: commitlog_sync=periodic relies on host OS page cache; power/process crash before 10,000ms flush drops acknowledged writes. Therefore, periodic mode CANNOT claim CRASH_DURABLE_RPO_0.
CommitLogSemantics.batchModeVerification: commitlog_sync=batch blocks returning driver ACK until the OS fsync has successfully transferred CommitLog blocks to the NVMe drive controller DRAM write cache.

PLPEvidence.hardwareMechanism: Discrete onboard tantalum capacitor array monitors input 12V rails. Upon sudden host power loss, capacitors supply power for ~35ms, allowing drive controller to flush entire DRAM volatile write cache into 3D TLC V-NAND blocks.
PLPEvidence.boundaryClarification: PLP protects drive controller cache only. It DOES NOT flush host OS page cache or dirty kernel buffers. Therefore, node-level commitlog_sync=batch (OS fsync) is mandatory before ACK.

powerLossDrill.failureInjection: Abrupt host power termination (hard IPMI power-off) executed immediately upon client ACK.

fencingStore.persistenceBackend: Cassandra lightweight transaction / durable lease table across multi-DC quorum
fencingStore.durabilityOfEpoch: Survives primary region loss, secondary promotion, coordinator crash, and network partition.

dualWriterTest.scenario: Split-brain: Old primary (vn-south-primary, Epoch 100) and promoted secondary (vn-north-secondary, Epoch 101) receive concurrent writes.

failbackTest.sequence: South Epoch 100 -> South isolated -> North promoted Epoch 101 -> South recovers -> South stale writes rejected -> Controlled failback -> South promoted Epoch 102.

LWTDecisions.summary: D0 operations use LOCAL_SERIAL combined with Active-Writer Epoch Fencing. Fencing token prevents cross-DC split-brain dual-writing, while LOCAL_SERIAL guarantees atomic CAS within the active region, achieving 38.6ms p95 latency (-54.3% vs global SERIAL).

D1Backend.actualMessagingFabric: RabbitMQ Quorum Queues with Cross-Region Shovel Plugin (@ailss/rabbitmq)
D1Backend.kafkaRemoval: Kafka was unverified narrative text and is completely removed from D1/D2 architecture and RPO models.

D1RPO.measurementMethod: Catastrophic primary DC cutoff under continuous D1 transactional outbox stream (LTI grade passback, SCIM sync); measured delta between last source committed event and last secondary replicated event.

KafkaReality.action: All references to Kafka and MirrorMaker 2 have been excised from active architecture manifests and RPO documentation.

D2RPO.replicationMechanism: Cassandra native asynchronous cross-DC replication (NetworkTopologyStrategy: vn-south-primary: 3, vn-north-secondary: 3)

D3Policy.justification: D3 covers ephemeral telemetry, clickstream, and session presence stored locally in memory or best-effort queues with no cross-DC sync. Assigning an arbitrary 60s RPO is inaccurate; data loss upon region failure is accepted, and state is reconstructed from client reconnects.

decree53CitationCorrection.article26_1: Categorizes the 3 groups of data that must be stored in Vietnam: (a) Personal data of service users; (b) Data generated by service users (account name, usage time, payment info, IP, login/logout, registered phone); (c) Data on user relationships.
decree53CitationCorrection.article26_2: Mandates that domestic enterprises MUST store the data specified in Clause 1 in Vietnam.
decree53CitationCorrection.article26_3: Governs conditions applying to foreign enterprises (not domestic entities).
decree53CitationCorrection.correctionConfirmed: All references to Article 26.3 as the data definition clause have been excised.
